mapper.select: select activity.id as activity_id, topic.id as topic_id, topic.member_id as topic_member_id, merchant.member_id as merchant_member_id, merchant.status as merchant_status, merchant.del_flag as merchant_del_flag, topic.product_type, topic.lifecycle as topic_lifecycle, topic.del_flag as topic_del_flag, topic.selling_started_at, topic.sale_end_at, topic.roam_referral_enabled, (select project_review.status from audit_task project_review where project_review.biz_type = 'TOPIC_PROJECT_REVIEW' and project_review.biz_id = topic.id order by project_review.submitted_at desc, project_review.id desc limit 1) as project_review_status, (select project_review.snapshot_json from audit_task project_review where project_review.biz_type = 'TOPIC_PROJECT_REVIEW' and project_review.biz_id = topic.id order by project_review.submitted_at desc, project_review.id desc limit 1) as project_review_snapshot_json, (select sale_review.status from audit_task sale_review where sale_review.biz_type = 'TOPIC_SALE_REVIEW' and sale_review.biz_id = topic.id order by sale_review.submitted_at desc, sale_review.id desc limit 1) as sale_review_status, activity.status as activity_status, activity.publish_status as activity_publish_status, activity.cancel_time as activity_cancel_time, activity.del_flag as activity_del_flag, ticket.id as ticket_id, ticket.owner_type as ticket_owner_type, ticket.owner_id as ticket_owner_id, ticket.del_flag as ticket_del_flag, ticket.remaining_inventory, ticket.signup_deadline, ticket.gather_lat, ticket.gather_lng, activity.name as title, topic.subtitle, activity.img_url as cover_img, ticket.meeting_point from cms_topic topic join cms_activity activity on activity.topic_id = topic.id join oms_ticket ticket on ticket.owner_type = 2 and ticket.owner_id = activity.id left join mms_merchant merchant on merchant.member_id = topic.member_id where ticket.gather_lat between #{minLat} and #{maxLat} and ticket.gather_lng between #{minLng} and #{maxLng}
